# The Rain Villas - Full Information

## Overview
Website: https://therainvillas.com
Type: Villa rental business (Lodging)
Location: Cisarua, Puncak, Bogor, West Java, Indonesia
Capacity: 20-50 guests per villa
Total Villas: 30+

## Features
- Private Pool
- Karaoke
- Billiard
- Gazebo
- BBQ Area
- Kitchen Set
- Smart TV & WiFi
- Parking
- Mountain View (select villas)

## Booking Policy
- DP: minimum 30% of villa price
- Full payment: due H-3 before check-in
- Reschedule: max H-7 before check-in with additional DP
- DP is non-refundable
- Late payment forfeits DP
- Check-out: 12.00 WIB (late checkout fee Rp 500.000)
- Extra guest: Rp 50.000/person if over capacity
- Prohibited: alcohol, drugs, sharp weapons, pets
- Quiet hours until 22.00 WIB
